configurePresets.name: windows-vs2026
configurePresets.description: Windows + Visual Studio 2026 generator (MSVC 14.5x, x64), vcpkg manifest deps. Produces a .sln solution. Requires VCPKG_ROOT; CMAKE_SYSTEM_VERSION pins the installed Windows 10 SDK so the generator does not fall back to a missing older one.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc2017
configurePresets.description: Windows + Visual Studio 2017 generator, x64, vcpkg manifest deps. Requires VCPKG_ROOT. (Legacy; VS 2017 hard-defaults to the often-missing Windows SDK 8.1, so prefer windows-vs2026 / windows-ninja.)

configurePresets.name: windows-ninja
configurePresets.description: Windows + Ninja generator, driven by a VS dev environment (run from a Developer Command Prompt, or source vcvarsall.bat x64 first). vcpkg manifest deps; requires VCPKG_ROOT and ninja on PATH.

configurePresets.name: linux-ninja
configurePresets.description: Linux + Ninja generator, vcpkg manifest deps. Requires VCPKG_ROOT and a compiler on PATH.
